name: Black Thrush
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of eastern, southeastern and southern mexico to northwestern nicaragua
description: Uncommon thrush of humid evergreen and pine-evergreen forest in highlands. Feeds mainly in fruiting trees and bushes, often with other thrushes; rarely feeds on the ground.

name: Wahlberg's Eagle
rangeDescription: Savanna of sub-saharan africa
description: A small brown eagle with a slighter head and weaker beak than in larger brown eagles. A short crest gives the head a distinct squared-off look.

name: White-fronted Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Arid southeastern peru (puno?) to northern argentina, paraguay, and southwestern brazil
description: Medium-sized pied woodpecker. Has a white forehead and a yellow or white throat and is grayish below with a barred mantle and tail.

name: Red-bellied Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Ndai (south-central solomon islands), temotu (southeastern solomon islands), and vanuatu to new caledonia (including loyalty islands)
description: A colorful dove, usually found in pairs, that can form large groups at fruiting trees. Appears mostly silver with green wings.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Maratua Shama
rangeDescription: Formerly maratua island (off northern borneo); probably extinct in the wild
description: Black with an orange belly and bright white crown; also note white rump. Endemic to Maratua Island, off northern Borneo, though almost certainly now extinct in the wild.

name: Yellow-faced Myna
rangeDescription: New guinea, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea) and aru islands (off southwestern new guinea)
description: A fairly large bird of lowland and foothill forest canopy. Mainly black plumage with yellow eye, belly and an orange-yellow bill with a thin yellow line leading down from the base.

name: Chestnut-bellied Chat-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia, ecuador (entire east slope, southward on the west slope to chimborazo), and far northern peru (east slope, north and west of the marañón valley)
description: Small, attractive flycatcher that lives near rushing streams inside Andean cloud forest. Its white eyebrows really stand out and can look like headlights in the dark forest; plumage is otherwise gray and chestnut.

name: Apurimac Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Andes of south-central peru (apurímac, cusco, and puno)
description: Localized red-headed sparrow-like bird. Has an ashy gray body, a rusty red head, a black face, and white lores and mustache.

name: Dwarf Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Lowlands of new guinea (except for northwestern new guinea and north coast of southeastern new guinea), also raja ampat islands (off western new guinea)
description: A tiny fruit dove of lowland and foothill rainforest. Mainly green with bright yellow vent.

name: Antillean Siskin
rangeDescription: Montane pine forest of hispaniola
description: A gregarious small seed-eating bird of pine forests and forest openings that also visits agricultural areas near dry scrubby forests. The male is unique in appearance with green upperparts, yellow underparts, a black head, and a thick pale bill.

name: Akiapolaau
rangeDescription: Montane koa forest of hawaii
description: A rare Hawaiian honeycreeper of native forests above 5,000 feet elevation on Hawaii Island. Appears bigger-headed and shorter-tailed than other honeycreepers.

name: Forbes's Blackbird
rangeDescription: Northeastern and eastern brazil, where very localized in pernambuco and alagoas, and northern minas gerais
description: Medium-sized, slim blackbird with uniform matte black plumage. Note the long straight bill with a straight upper mandible.

name: Black-belted Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Philippines (panay and negros); probably extinct on guimaras
description: A small bird of forest and fairly open woodland from the lowlands to lower elevations in the mountains. Black above, glossed blue, with white underparts marked by a red patch from the chest to the belly, bordered with black around the top.

name: Biak Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A small owl endemic to a variety of forests on Biak Island. Dark plumage, paler belly with fine barring and white lines from the shoulder.

name: Small-billed Elaenia
rangeDescription: Southern brazil to bolivia and central argentina; winters north to colombia
description: A fairly small and very dull-looking flycatcher. Grayish brown above and whitish below with a thin white eyering, three pale wingbars, and pinkish base to the bill.

name: Buru Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Forest and village trees in lowlands of buru (southwestern moluccas)
description: A brightly-colored green pigeon confined to the island of Buru. Mainly green, with pale markings in the wing forming a striking band.

name: Eye-ringed Thistletail
rangeDescription: Andes of central peru (junín)
description: Well-named bird found only in a small area of the eastern Andes in central Peru. Like other thistletails, it is gray and brown with a long, wispy tail and an orange chin.

name: Pitt Island Shag
rangeDescription: Chatham islands (new zealand)
description: A small, slender gray shag, with a slender bill, yellow legs and feet, and small dark spots on its shoulder and wing feathers. Feeds, roosts, and breeds around rocky shorelines of the Chatham Islands.

name: Luzon Buttonquail
rangeDescription: Luzon (northern philippines)
description: A fairly small, rare, little-known ground bird from the highland grasslands of Luzon. Overall brown, heavily patterned with dark-centered feathers overlaid with pale buff streaking.

name: Doria's Hawk
rangeDescription: New guinea, including and batanta (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A large, inconspicuous raptor of lowlands and foothill forest interior. Brown back and long tail with strong barring, pale underparts with strong sparse streaking, pale eye-brow and a thick dark eye-stripe.
